name: IM-2 Athena
tagline: Landed on its side in a crater near the lunar south pole
description: Athena is the Nova-C lander of Intuitive Machines' second Moon mission, about 4.3 m tall, with a LOX and liquid-methane main engine. It touched down on 2025-03-06 near Mons Mouton, about 160 km from the south pole, at 84.7906 S, 29.1957 E, inside a crater 20 m across. Its laser altimeter gave noisy readings all the way down, it hit the surface faster than intended, and it came to rest on its side with its solar panels away from the Sun. The hopper and the rovers did not deploy, and the mission ended in under 13 hours.
best_known_for: Landed on its side in a crater near the lunar south pole
